cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
import numpy as np

mols=[]; coords=[]
for name,s in [('dipic','O=C([O-])c1cccc(C(=O)[O-])n1'),('terpy','n1c(-c2ccccn2)cccc1-c1ccccn1')]:
 m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
 AllChem.Compute2DCoords(m)
 c=m.GetConformer(); p=c.GetPositions()*0.94
 if name=='dipic':
  p[[0,2]]=p[[2,0]]
  nc=11; neighbors=[3,7]
 else:
  # Rotate the right-hand terminal pyridine into its chelating orientation.
  origin=p[11].copy(); axis=p[12]-origin; axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
  for i in range(13,18):
   v=p[i]-origin; p[i]=origin+2*np.dot(v,axis)*axis-v
  nc=0; neighbors=[1,11]
 for i,xyz in enumerate(p): c.SetAtomPosition(i,xyz)
 m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
 assert AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m)
 AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1500)
 p=m.GetConformer().GetPositions()
 center=p[nc].copy()
 inward=np.mean(p[neighbors],axis=0)-center; inward/=np.linalg.norm(inward)
 across=p[neighbors[1]]-p[neighbors[0]]
 across-=np.dot(across,inward)*inward; across/=np.linalg.norm(across)
 norm=np.cross(across,inward)
 rel=p-center
 lx=rel@across; ly=rel@inward; lz=rel@norm
 if name=='dipic':
  p=np.column_stack((-2.15-ly,lx,lz))
 else:
  p=np.column_stack((2.15+ly,lz,lx))
 print(name,rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m), 'atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
 for i in ([2,10,11] if name=='dipic' else [0,7,17]): print('donor',i+1+sum(x.GetNumAtoms() for x in mols),p[i],np.linalg.norm(p[i]))
 coords.extend(p); mols.append(m)
xyz=[('Ag',np.zeros(3))]
for mol,p in zip(mols,[coords[:mols[0].GetNumAtoms()],coords[mols[0].GetNumAtoms():]]):
 for a,pos in zip(mol.GetAtoms(),p): xyz.append((a.GetSymbol(),pos))
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(xyz)}\nAg(II) dipicolinate terpyridine; neutral, S=1/2; Cartesian angstrom\n')
 for sym,p in xyz: f.write(f'{sym:2} {p[0]: .9f} {p[1]: .9f} {p[2]: .9f}\n')
PY
python build.py

from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np
lines=Path('freeoptimized.xyz').read_text().splitlines()
n=int(lines[0]); atoms=[line.split()[0] for line in lines[2:2+n]]
p=np.array([[float(v) for v in line.split()[1:4]] for line in lines[2:2+n]])
p-=p[0].copy()
assert n==45 and Counter(atoms)==Counter({'Ag':1,'C':22,'H':14,'N':4,'O':4})
assert np.isfinite(p).all()
with Path('answer.xyz').open('w') as f:
 f.write(f'{n}\nAg(II) dipicolinate-terpyridine complex, S=1/2; Ag(C7H3NO4)(C15H11N3); angstroms\n')
 for s,v in zip(atoms,p): f.write(f'{s:2s} {v[0]: .10f} {v[1]: .10f} {v[2]: .10f}\n')
assert Path('answer.xyz').is_file()
print('Confirmed answer.xyz exists; 45 atoms, including 14 hydrogens.')
